claims.quote: Two mutations, c.545A>T (p.Asn182Ile and c.2638C>A (p.Leu880Met) were reported here as a novel mutation.
Whole exome sequencing revealed mutations in KCN2 gene, which is a member of Potassium channels (KCN) gene family associated with epileptic encephalopathies.
the computational analysis showed their effect on protein binding site and function suggesting their role in the development of early infantile epileptic encephalopathy 57.
